request_origin: user-specified after inspection of the converged MACE-EF/open24a result

response_map.initial_source: c0 = Q*dE_MACE-EF/df evaluated at zero external field

comparators: previously recorded converged source boundary energy
primary_questions: How far is U_segment_COSMO(c2) from the converged boundary energy?
Does the second unmixed update contract or amplify the source change relative to the first?
Does truncation avoid the large response amplification seen at the converged root?

experimental_label_policy.comparison_name: partial-component difference from total FreeSolv label

forbidden_repairs: choose a different iteration count after seeing these results
mix or scale c2 to improve experimental agreement
fit COSMO energy or cavity radii
promote c2 as a stationary or variational solution

claim_boundary.does_establish: A reproducible two-map response and conductor-COSMO component diagnostic on the frozen FreeSolv-20 geometries.
claim_boundary.does_not_establish: A complete hydration free energy, a converged root, stationary energy, passivity, forces, PES, or release admission.
